description: Run the same simplified effective-rate scenario as the website Tax Savings Calculator for selected origin, income, subdivision and income type. This is a directional model, not a tax-return calculation; it omits deductions, credits, sourcing, payroll/self-employment tax, treaties, destination-country tax and individual facts.

income.description: Annual income in the model currency, from 30,000 to 1,000,000.

income_type.description: Income type. FEIE is modeled only for US employment or freelance income.

subdivision.description: US state or Canadian province from the model; omit for the default rate curve.

name: estimate_tax_savings
title: Estimate a directional tax-savings scenario
